name: Gulf Shores Seafood
description: Gulf Shores Seafood is a locally owned and operated seafood market located in the heart of Gulf Shores, Alabama, across from Waterville USA. The store has been providing residents and visitors with the finest local seafood for over 60 years. Owners Gina and Patrick Daily purchased the business in 2000 and made it their goal to offer only the freshest Alabama Gulf Seafood as well as prepared meals to go. The market offers fresh Snapper, Grouper, Yellowfin Tuna, Flounder, Crabmeat, Oysters, Seafood Dips, live or cooked Crawfish, and catering services for any event.
